limitations: Current September security master, market capitalization and sector assignments are frozen across the requested history; this is not a point-in-time or survivorship-free universe.
Original API receipt timestamps remain in cache. Exploratory replay explicitly models historical daily availability at close; current-session opening price is assumed available at the open.
Historical ranking is frozen daily; live scanner defaults to 15-minute refresh. Their signal opportunities can differ.
No historical bid/ask, queue position or borrow/locate and recall records were obtained. OHLC-path quotes and fixed displayed depth are execution assumptions, not observed quotes.
No-adjust bars can cross corporate actions. Historical adjustment knowledge and sector classification have not been verified.
Intraday-flat borrow interest is modeled as zero; fees, margin requirements and short permissions depend on the account.
Passing synthetic engineering checks does not establish profitability or incremental alpha.
